scientific_integrity: Analytic trace and Dirichlet-path proofs establish all-dimensional and infinite-dimensional statements. Finite exact-rational and numerical checks are supplementary. No independent assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to complex one-step nilpotent and unilateral Schatten-fourth weighted shifts, not arbitrary matrices, arbitrary p, or arbitrary bounded shifts. Full Gao–Hou–Zhao (2026) article was not accessible; implicit prior coverage remains a named risk.
title: Sharp weighted Schatten-fourth radii of nilpotent shifts
